definition.prefix: bridge_observe(..., use_text_prefix=True) prepends the previous last_bridge_text plus a newline to the step input; the first step has no prefix
definition.expression: the 20 describe sentences still produce the expected paired texts
definition.control: the bridged trajectory equals a plain observe run on the same prefixed bytes
definition.difference: the bridged trajectory differs from a no-prefix observe run on at least one step
definition.unknown: an unknown input clears the text; the following step carries no prefix
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.prefix: 19/20 steps carry a prefix; the first carries none; each prefix equals the previous text
criteria.control: 20/20 state hashes equal to the prefixed plain run
criteria.difference: at least 1 of 20 state hashes differs from the no-prefix run
criteria.unknown: unknown expression is no_pair, text None; the next step has prefix None
criteria.parameters: parameter hash and table digest unchanged
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.rerun: the R33 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
